hero.description: Expand international partner networks, promote student exchange, and bring international standard experiences to 5 campuses nationwide.

about.headline: Pioneering university in technology talent training, closely associated with businesses and global partner networks.
about.description: The International Relations Department connects FPT University with universities, organizations, and enterprises worldwide — from student exchange and research collaboration to campus visits at 5 facilities.

campus.title: 5 campuses nationwide
campus.subtitle: From Hanoi to Can Tho — each campus is a unique space for learning, working, and welcoming international partners according to distinct standards.

partners.title: Partners & International Cooperation
partners.subtitle: A strong network of partners with universities and enterprises locally and internationally, providing numerous practical experience opportunities.

process.title: Visit Request Process
process.subtitle: Simple and transparent — from request submission to the actual visit.
process.step1Desc: Fill out visit registration and delegation details via the online form.
process.step2Desc: International Relations Department receives and reviews the partner's request.
process.step3Desc: A host is assigned to prepare for and welcome the delegation.
process.step4Desc: The visit schedule is confirmed and sent back to the partner.

cta.title: Ready to connect with FPT University?
cta.subtitle: Register for a visit or contact the International Relations Department directly to begin our partnership journey.
